glossary.definition: (1) "Appropriate local legislative authority" means the board of county commissioners or the legislative authority of a municipal corporation within whose jurisdiction the majority of impacted residents are located.
glossary.source_title: Section 5517.05 - Sound barrier notice and hearing.

glossary.definition:
(2) "Impacted residents" means those persons residing in the immediate area of the proposed location of the sound barrier.
